info.title: slopwatch
info.description: CLI tool for detecting LLM-generated "sloppy" code patterns in .NET projects

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze files for LLM-generated code patterns

options.name: --files
options.description: Specific files to analyze (can be multiple)

options.name: --min-severity
options.description: Minimum severity to report: info, warning, error (default: warning)

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit with code 1 if issues at this severity or higher: info, warning, error (default: error)

options.name: --no-baseline
options.description: Skip baseline checking - report ALL detections (useful for initial setup)

options.name: --create-baseline
options.description: Create a baseline file from current detections (skips normal output)

options.name: --update-baseline
options.description: Add new detections to an existing baseline file

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show verbose output including baseline loading details

options.name: --hook
options.description: Hook mode for Claude Code integration: only analyzes git dirty files for speed, outputs errors to stderr, suppresses other output, fails on warnings by default, exits with code 2 on failure

options.name: --stats
options.description: Show analysis statistics (files analyzed, time elapsed)

options.name: --parallel
options.description: Number of parallel workers for file analysis (default: processor count, 0 = sequential)

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize slopwatch in a project - creates baseline from existing code

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing baseline file if it exists

options.name: --min-severity
options.description: Minimum severity to baseline: info, warning, error (default: info)
